place.raw: Pilesgrove, Salem, New Jersey, United States

notes: NAME LIKELY CORRUPTED (research 2026-07-03): no source uses 'Dolliver' as part of this man's name. Every source found (Van Name, 'The Elwell Family,' 1919; Elwell/Pope, 'The Elwell Family in America,' 1899; Geni; WikiTree Elwell-60) calls him simply Thomas Elwell (1654 Gloucester, MA – 1706 Pilesgrove, NJ), son of the immigrant Robert Elwell. The Dolliver connection is real but belongs to a sibling/spouse relationship (Robert Elwell's daughter Mary Elwell married Samuel Dolliver in Gloucester in 1654), not to this man's own name; 'Dolliver' and the '8gg' (8th-great-grandparent) suffix both look like a prior researcher's generation/branch tag that got folded into the name field.
